question: Eligibility criteria of the CREA-MEDIA-2021-TVONLINE programme and compliance with Regulation 2021/818

The eligibility criteria of the CREA-MEDIA-2021-TVONLINE programme state that applicants must be independent European audiovisual producers established in one of the countries participating in the MEDIA strand of the Creative Europe Programme and owned directly or by majority participation by nationals from those countries.

This requirement and Article 1(n) of Directive 2010/13/EU – which states that European works are subject to conditions relating to the establishment of the production, which, in turn, cannot be controlled by producers established outside the Member States – contradict the provisions on eligibility laid down in Regulation 2021/818, which do not make a point of whom applicants may be owned or controlled by. 1.
Does the Commission use Regulation 2021/818 as the legal basis for establishing the eligibility criteria of the CREA-MEDIA-2021-TVONLINE programme?
Why has this eligibility criterion remained unchanged, when it is set out in Article 17 of Regulation (EC) No 2021/818, in a way that is not in line with point 6.1 of the programme?
